artifacts.cost_tracker: Usage proxy artifacts from task bec4a6ee (see schemas/cost_tracker.schema.json).

run_classification.applies_to_tasks_note_2026_08_02: a46bf007 (the 3:40 PM ET live-run watchdog) was removed from the schedule entirely on 2026-08-02; 67aa802b was also retimed the same day, from 3:35 PM ET to 5:00 PM ET daily.
rules: Validate scheduled state files against schemas/run_classification.schema.json before use.
Collect every order_id in manual_runs/**/run_state*.json and exclude them from all scheduled-live metrics.
Exclude any run_state with run_origin='manual' or manual_run=true, regardless of file path.
Never infer scheduled status from same-day broker orders alone; a valid scheduled run_state must exist.
Broker time-window fallback (15:15-15:35 ET) is allowed only when a valid scheduled state exists but lacks order IDs due to a known write failure; manual order IDs stay excluded.
Scheduled-live cost basis, slippage, reliability, and order-count metrics come only from validated scheduled runs.

manual_reporting.rule: Manual fills may appear only in a clearly labeled 'Manual Test Runs' section and must not affect scheduled-live cost basis, slippage, reliability, or order-count metrics.

requirements.local_first: Daily live runs write structured JSON/CSV locally first.
requirements.coverage_report: Every manual or scheduled run produces a DCA Manual Run Slippage and Coverage Report where fills exist, or a compact run artifact explaining no fills.
requirements.slippage_tracking: Track target_price and slippage for every future trade.
requirements.notion_updates: The post-trade task (67aa802b) updates only the compact Notion Latest Run section; the weekly Friday task (041d9d90) recalculates and refreshes the full performance dashboard.
requirements.cost_tracker_proxy: The cost tracker is a proxy-based tracker in Notion/dashboard docs/config; exact Perplexity credit consumption is not exposed, so do not claim exact credits.

cost_control.manual_runs: Avoid manual full runs unless automation fails.
